### Introduction

In this textbook, we have relied upon datasets available in various packages. The base R also comes with some in-built datasets like `mtcars` and `iris`. We have used these datasets in some of the examples. We have also used `penguins` dataset from the `palmerpenguins` package. In the @sec-packages, you will find how to install these packages.

After installing the package, you will also need to load the package in the system every time you want to use it. This can be done using the `library` command as shown in the @sec-packages. After the package is loaded, you can use the datasets contained in the package.
